prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: ENV01 backdrop layer for original mobile puzzle game Almost God. A LANDSCAPE 3:2 canvas, 1536 by 1024. Fully opaque image.
Primary request: Paint a distant Mediterranean storybook harbor in warm gouache on textured paper. This is only the FAR BACKDROP of a five-layer playable scene: the actual plaza floor, near architecture, foreground plants, characters, and playable water are added separately.
Composition: Very wide, cheerful theatrical composition. The upper 30 percent has pale morning sky with painterly cream clouds, softly layered blue mountains, a small island lighthouse in the upper left, and a tiny apricot-colored village with terracotta roofs along the distant upper-right shore. The horizon is high at about 30 percent of canvas height. The bottom 70 percent is a quiet, low-contrast blue-green painted wash suggesting distant harbor light; it will be mostly covered by a separate floor layer. Keep central action space clear and visually calm. Buildings remain small in the distance.
Style: polished hand-painted gouache children's adventure book, rich broad brushstrokes, readable simplified geometry, gentle whimsy, warm cream light, turquoise water, muted sage greens, clay orange roofs, subtle lavender shadows. Avoid photographic realism. No harsh outlines.
Constraints: ONLY distant scenery on a complete opaque landscape canvas. No near pier, no foreground quay, no near plants, no stage props, no boat, no bollard, no rope, no characters, no UI, no lettering, no watermark. Do not imitate a portrait phone screenshot. Do not show a giant central building.
